etym.s: [cf. Lat. findo; Germ. beissen; Eng. bite.]

spans.s: 2. भि॑द् mfn. (ifc.) breaking, splitting, piercing, destroying, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pur. (cf. अश्म-, गिरि-, तमो-, पुर-भिद् &c.)
splitting, bursting, destroying, destruction, Kāv. (cf. दुर्-भिद)
भिदा—भृत् mfn. ‘broken’ or ‘enduring separation’, Śiś. vi, 5.
(from an irreg. Caus. भिदापय) causing to break or pound or trample on BhP.
easily split or broken, fragile, brittle, Mālatīm. (cf. Vām. v, 2, 60)
divided, variegated, mingled or mingling with, Śiś.
a chain for an elephant's feet, L.
भिदुर—स्वन m. ‘making a piercing noise’, N. of an Asura, Hariv.
easily broken, brittle, fragile, Sadukt. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 96,
a rushing river or N. of a r˚, Ragh.; Bhaṭṭ. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 115)
splitting, breaking, destroying (cf. पूर्-भि॑द्य and शीर्ष-भि॑द्य)
